question: True or false: from 2031, EU law requires new electric-car batteries to contain at least a quarter recycled lithium?
answer: False. The EU Batteries Regulation sets 6% for lithium from 2031, rising to 12% from 2036; nickel starts at 6%, cobalt at 16%. Higher shares would be impossible, because few batteries have yet come back. Lead, whose recycling loop has run for a century, gets 85% from the same year.
move: A target reveals what supply the rule-makers believe exists.
trap: Assuming a green law would demand a large recycled share at once.
reference: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 of the European Parliament and of the Council concerning batteries and waste batteries, Article 8, 2023
